about: Orekit 13.1 exact UTC samples. Classical matrices start in EME2000 (the bias-free J2000 origin called GCRF by FFM coords), IERS 1996, no EOP corrections. ITRF starts in GCRF, IERS 2010, simpleEOP=true, minimum supported EOP interpolation degree 3 (degrees must be 4k-1). Frame providers evaluated without transform interpolation.
